intro: Congratulations on acquiring the Spinny Head Stabilizer. This device employs resonant frequencies to synchronize your cognitive processes.

sections.title: Installation
sections.body:
1. Affix the stabilizer atop your head.
2. Engage the resonance mechanism.
3. Await cessation of rotational oscillation.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.body: In the event of accelerated ideation, modify the ring by rotating it 15 degrees in an anti-clockwise direction.

warnings: Prohibition against use during operation of heavy machinery or manipulation of temporal portals.
